title: Shop: group duplicate secrets by name in Sell a secret
acceptance: Copies of the same secret (same name) are adjacent in Sell a secret, groups ordered by their best copy's sell value then name, copies inside a group by value desc
A name with 2+ copies renders once with a x N count and one compact line per copy (level, last copy if any, its own Sell button); single secrets render exactly as before
Each copy keeps its own Sell button, price by its own level, the last-copy confirm and the toast naming the card; server calls unchanged
Capture scene with duplicates exists; unit tests pin the ordering and the grouping
